metadata.label: Bulk
metadata.description:
Ballerina Salesforce connector provides the capability to access Salesforce Bulk API.
This connector lets you to perform bulk data operations for CSV, JSON, and XML data types.

metadata.label: Salesforce
metadata.description:
Ballerina Salesforce connector provides the capability to access Salesforce REST API.
This connector lets you to perform operations for SObjects, query using SOQL, search using SOSL, and describe SObjects
and organizational data.

metadata.label: Pubsub Publisher
metadata.description:
Publishes a batch of events to one configured Salesforce topic. Transport
operations are added behind this topic-bound public abstraction.

metadata.label: Soap
metadata.description:
Ballerina Salesforce SOAP connector provides the capability to access Salesforce SOAP API. 
This connector lets you to perform operations like create, retrieve, update or delete sobjects, such as accounts,
leads, custom objects, and etc..

metadata.label: Apex
metadata.description:
Ballerina Salesforce Apex Client provides the capability to access Salesforce Apex REST API.
This client allows you to perform operations for custom Apex REST endpoints, execute HTTP methods on these endpoints,
and handle responses appropriately.

metadata.label: Marketing Cloud
metadata.description: Salesforce Marketing Cloud APIs provide programmatic access to features such as Address, Assets (Content Builder), Audit, Contacts, Data Events, Event Notification, Interactions (Journey Builder), Push, SMS, Transactional Messaging, and Messaging. Refer to the official Salesforce documentation for detailed API usage and guidelines.

metadata.label: Salesforce Pardot
metadata.description:
This is a generated connector for [Salesforce Pardot API v5](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/pardot/guide/version5overview.html) OpenAPI specification.
The version 5 of the Pardot API to read and update a variety of assets and objects, like File and Layout Template objects.

metadata.label: Bulkv2
metadata.description:
Ballerina Salesforce Bulk v2 Client provides the capability to access Salesforce Bulk API v2.
This client allows you to perform bulk data operations such as creating, querying, updating, and deleting large volumes of data. 
You can create and manage bulk jobs, upload data, check job status, and retrieve job results efficiently.

metadata.label: Salesforce Einstein
metadata.description: This is a generated connector for [Einstein Vision and Einstein Language API](https://metamind.readme.io/reference#predictive-vision-service-api) OpenAPI specification. Allows you to access the Einstein Vision and Einstein Language services via the standard REST API calls. Use the APIs to programmatically work with datasets, labels, examples, models, and predictions.

metadata.label: Datacloud
metadata.description:
Write records to Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), read unified profiles and calculated insights back,
and trigger the identity resolution and insight runs that build them.

Data Cloud serves its APIs from two hosts with two different tokens. The `Runs` operations go to the
core Salesforce org with the core access token. Every other operation goes to the Data Cloud tenant
endpoint with a Data Cloud token. This client takes the core org credentials only: on the first tenant
call it exchanges the core token at `POST {serviceUrl}/services/a360/token` for a Data Cloud token and
the tenant endpoint, caches both, exchanges again shortly before the token expires, and on a `401` from
the tenant endpoint exchanges again and retries the call once. When the org rejects the core token
itself, the client fetches a new one from the configured OAuth2 grant and retries once.
